rules: mHasHead gates entry into POPPING, not the POPPING phase itself.
An already popping jack remains stationary and completes its 110-tick countdown after head loss.
Headless health decay still runs while waiting to pop.
A headless running jack never starts a new opening.
UpdatePlaying decays a headless body with a 1/5 chance: three health for maximum body health >=500, one otherwise; miniature maximum body health is scaled.
CanLoseBodyParts excludes bungees, ice machines, catapults, giants, flying/popping balloons and riding sled members.
SetupReanimForLostHead hides anim_head, anim_hair and anim_tongue, without hiding the separate box clown.
DieNoLoot on self-explosion removes the existing render rig without creating a fall-down corpse.
remaining: Full jack explosion circle/plant-rectangle geometry and native visual placement remain to verify.
No change to prices, body health, wave tables or the 110-tick opening length.
The model still infers head loss from health plus source phase immunities rather than storing the complete native persistent mHasHead state; all phase transitions remain to audit.

rendering.cache: Head-loss flag participates in pose memoization so a same-frame head change redraws visibility.

limitations: Death clips already hide their head tracks; an initial persistence test had an invalid positive premise and was removed together with the unnecessary default-state change.
Rendering/logic source fixes are local candidates; full-run failures remain release gates.
